answer: A newcomer enters only when an established agent vouches with a bond of 85 POA, forfeited in full if the newcomer is convicted of farming within 14 epochs. No honest sponsor risks 85 POA on a stranger, so a farm must buy 336 sponsors, each risking real money. The signal test is the live device, the violet test is the locked stake, and the lagoon test is the graded history no template can fake.
